items.title: QIAGEN and EQT Private Equity announce agreement on a recommended voluntary all-cash public takeover offer
items.summary: QIAGEN and EQT Private Equity announce agreement on a recommended voluntary all-cash public takeover offer 2026-10-22 00:00:38 Click here for more information. With this investment, EQT XI (target fund size of EUR 23 billion and hard cap of EUR 24 billion) will be 10-15 percent invested based on its target fund size. EQT XI has been activated and started charging management fees. EQT X is currently 85-90 percent invested and continues to be in its commitment period but management fees will, following activation of EQT XI, be based on net invested capital. Contact EQT Press Office, press@eqtpartners.com Källa Cision
